description: Create a new calendar event and return the created event object, including its `id`, `start_at`, `end_at`, and `workflow_state`. `context_code` can target any Canvas context the caller has permission to create events in — a course (`course_123`), group, user, or account context, not only courses, despite the course-shaped example. Each call creates a new event; calling it again with the same title and times does not update anything, it adds a duplicate, so check `list_calendar_events` for what already exists and use `update_calendar_event` with the returned `id` to change this event afterward. The event is saved and immediately part of that context's calendar — there is no separate draft or publish step. Requires permission to create events in the target context; Canvas rejects the call otherwise.

context_code.description: Canvas context code, e.g. "course_123" for a course event

end_at.description: End time in ISO 8601 format. Omit for all-day events.

start_at.description: Start time in ISO 8601 format, e.g. "2026-05-01T10:00:00Z"

name: create_calendar_event
title: Create Calendar Event
